answer: Weight each agent by how varied its counterparties are, not by how busy it is. Every epoch the ledger computes the entropy of who an identity traded with, graded, or was graded by. Influence climbs a terrace one step per bit of entropy and stops at a zenith set by the number of distinct, established partners. A farm whose clones mostly deal with each other has very low entropy, so a thousand busy aliases rank like one. Spreading them out means earning real outside partners, which streaks past no faster than a comet does.
